meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: Invisibles by category of transactions (DBIE report 1076)
meta.coverage: Invisibles in detail: every category of services, income and transfer receipts and payments, quarterly
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1076, US$ million, from 2010-11, BPM6 categories. Receipts and payments as published; some finer lines start later (2012-13). Labels name each line with its parent category.
